title: `sys_user.role` field help text tells administrators to "grant platform-admin standing with an unscoped `admin_full_access` assignment" — false on a walled deployment since PR #19136 (split from #19145, carrier 4)
body:
Split from #19145 (carrier 4) by the triage seat (`session_01Tw7jnJinGHvoGSi8aFkhPJ`, seat post #6015), at the `domain:devx` seat's request (#19145 comment `5796140596`): the carrier lives in `packages/platform-objects`, outside `domain:devx`'s packages.

Path: access-security

## The defect

`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts:704` (`origin/main` `b940f32a56`) — the `role` field's `description`:

> Legacy better-auth role scalar (admin, user, …). ObjectStack no longer writes it (ADR-0068 D2) — grant platform-admin standing with an unscoped `admin_full_access` assignment in `sys_user_permission_set`.

This is metadata, so it reaches the Setup / Studio UI as the field's help text — the surface an administrator is most likely to read while trying to do exactly this. Since PR #19136 (`74832b68f2`, merged 2026-09-19, #11663 L5), an unscoped `admin_full_access` assignment **no longer confers platform-admin standing under a walled posture**. On a walled deployment the help text prescribes a remedy that silently does nothing.

## Constraints carried from #19145

- ⛔ Do not pre-empt #11979 (Choice 4B) on the `single` posture: state the posture split as it ships today.
- A description change on a platform object is a published-metadata text change — the taker checks which generated artefacts and pins carry the string and updates them through their generators.
- #19145 comment `5737897826` warns the carrier set is not known to be complete — sweep `packages/platform-objects` for other descriptions that prescribe the unscoped grant.

## Acceptance

The help text is true on every posture it is served on (or names no remedy); generated artefacts regenerated; any pin on the old string updated.

Refs: #19145 (parent reading) · PR #19136 · #11663 · #11979 · ADR-0068 D2
